text: At its meeting on July 9, 2024 the Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee considered Item NP6.1 and made recommendations to City Council. Summary from the report (June 27, 2024) from the City Clerk: The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.

City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Monica Purdy to the Property Standards Committee - North York Panel for a term of office ending October 12, 2027, and until a successor is appointed: 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachment 1 to the Decision Letter (July 9, 2024) from the Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about an identifiable individual being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
